A Comprehensive Catalogue of the Various Sections of the Mantra Secret Teachings of the Ācāryas, extensively compiled from both old and new *dhāraṇī* methods, collected by the Tiantai Śramaṇa Anran. Anran’s Preface: I have humbly examined the catalogues of the various Ācāryas.
Furthermore, from among the scriptures recorded in the *Zhengyuan lu*,
he extracted those newly introduced sūtras and dharmas to establish them as the doctrinal gateway of the Mantra school.
Among the various dhāraṇī methods translated by earlier scholars,
none were adopted; consequently,
students failed to understand their origins, as they lacked broad learning.
Now, based on the Secret Records of the Eight Houses,
they are categorized into twenty classes;
within each class, further subdivisions of dharma categories are established.
Within these various categories, some have been supplemented with older translations;
although they are not divine mantras, they nevertheless serve as objects for invoking vows and aspirations.
Furthermore, among the various catalogs, some rely on the original records, retaining only the abbreviated titles.
Some have listed the extensive names according to their own preferences,
yet this makes it difficult for later generations to discern the actual traces of the origins. Therefore,
I shall now record the titles of both the root and the branches.
It also demonstrates the differences and agreements regarding what is included or omitted.
Furthermore, among the various catalogs,
there are those [teachings] which the various ācāryas kept secret and did not record.
If there are those who see or hear [this], they shall likewise be granted [merit].
